title: Configuration-based custom harnesses and supported-suite contributions
reference: Current Cordyceps conversation: user identifies an author of a harness as a possible new persona and requests support for adding their own harness or contributing a PR to the supported suite. Proposes a plugin system or registry using files such as claude-code.json and codex.json to supply provider overrides, ACP invocation and other setup data alongside an installed binary. Exact schema and plugin execution model remain proposals.
